name: linkedin
description: LinkedIn posting and analytics: personal and organization page posts, engagement metrics

auth.label: LinkedIn OAuth
auth.hint: Create a LinkedIn OAuth app at developer.linkedin.com; scopes cover profile, member + organization social posting, and org admin. Supports multi-account via credentialName.

marketplace.tagline: Publish to LinkedIn and track engagement from agent workflows — personal or organization page posts and analytics.
useCases: Publish posts to a personal profile or organization page
Schedule a content queue across pages
Manage organization content as an admin
marketplace.permissionsSummary: Post, delete, and read analytics for LinkedIn content via OAuth. Posting and deleting are public, mutating actions; deletes are irreversible.
